review.why: Runs a full blog workflow from one command: write, rewrite, score, brief, audit, repurpose and translate, with gated delivery.
review.summary: An orchestrator that routes about thirty commands to sub-skills and five agents: writing, rewriting, briefs, calendars, SEO and schema checks, topic clusters, AI-citation audits, repurposing, multilingual publishing and content-decay detection. A five-gate delivery contract with a 100-point score blocks a draft until it passes, with at most three repair loops.
strengths: Draft is delivered only after the gates pass; fabricated statistics are not tolerated
Project files and fetched pages are treated as untrusted data and loaded through a fencing helper
Says its readiness score does not prove rankings or citations
cautions: Needs thirty-odd sub-skills, agents, scripts and twenty-two references that are not in this file
Routing table and rules dominate: the real writing method lives in the sub-skills
